purpose: Select realistic Indian Ocean reinforcements from the reconciled Branch wallet while preserving Central-Pacific opportunity cost and using submarine/observation liaison as the primary mission.

corrected_shipbuilding_logic.young_surface_advantage: primarily avoided historical Solomon/Rabaul losses plus higher availability; only modest 2-5% construction acceleration
corrected_shipbuilding_logic.kaibokan: modest quantity delta; role separation/availability, not dozens of extra 1943 hulls
corrected_shipbuilding_logic.warning: Global physical count now closes at center 103 from named loss-path audit. Theater-transfer availability remains much smaller than physical count.

initial_release_rule.when: Eastern Fleet reinforcement is highly probable/eastbound but has not yet sortied east from Ceylon
initial_release_rule.upper_transfer_without_explicit_Pacific_: 8-11 total modern DD; above this requires explicit Central-Pacific tradeoff
initial_release_rule.CL_release: Oyodo first; Agano or Noshiro only on second gate; Yahagi NO-GO early Jan
initial_release_rule.CA_release: none initially; Suzuya/Kumano pair only on Bay-entry escalation gate
initial_release_rule.secondary_carriers: no automatic commitment; one/two only if later air-risk gate and Pacific situation permit

preferred_initial_mobile_group.initial_strength: Oyodo + 4 modern DD center (1 Akizuki-type + 3 Yugumo-type); fifth DD optional only after origin/maintenance check
preferred_initial_mobile_group.basing: Singapore/Lingga rear; forward operation through Penang/Sabang; do not park the whole group at Port Blair
mission: receive DF/ESM/submarine/air-search reports and maintain one operational plot
perform one-pass Type-93 interception only on fresh high-confidence contact
avoid sustained radar gunnery battle against a screened British battle fleet

why_these_DD.Niizuki_Teruzuki: mature Akizuki hulls whose historical Solomon losses are absent; radar/AA/picket utility is unusually valuable for the observation network
why_these_DD.Takanami_Makinami_Kiyonami_Onami: mature 1942-early-1943 Yugumo hulls, historical loss chains absent, enough training time by Jan1 and no current Branch commitment found
why_these_DD.Suzunami_Hayanami: mid-1943 Yugumo completions with adequate work-up; usable alternates
why_these_DD.late_1943_Yugumo: Asashimo/Kishinami/Okinami are not first-choice Indian transfers because their late-1943 completion leaves less work-up despite modest Branch schedule improvement

second_gate_if_Eastern_Fleet_sorties_eas.add_Akizuki: the other of Niizuki/Teruzuki or another available Akizuki after Pacific screen check
second_gate_if_Eastern_Fleet_sorties_eas.submarines: raise Indian Ocean on-station target to 7-9 conventional boats; Sentaka 1-2 only if stale-contact-to-intercept geometry justifies transfer

third_gate_if_RN_enters_Bay_Andaman_appr.role: fast heavy cover/deterrence and night strike support; not daylight line battle against QE/Valiant/Renown under carrier air
third_gate_if_RN_enters_Bay_Andaman_appr.Pacific_tradeoff: explicitly recheck Central Pacific carrier/surface screen before GO

special_support.Chitose_or_Chiyoda: one may be screened for Singapore/Sabang mobile seaplane maintenance/recon support because Branch retains them as seaplane tenders; exact Jan location/readiness must be traced
special_support.Nisshin: candidate for one/two fast heavy-equipment/AA/engineer transplant runs to Andamans; not combat surface group
special_support.old_local_cruisers: Ashigara/Aoba plus Kuma/Kinu/Oi/Kitakami layer remains for local cover, transport and presence; do not waste modern group on routine shuttle work

submarine_local_nucleus.jan7_clock: I-162 + I-166 remain out; RO-110, I-165 and RO-111 can be out/heading to station = 5 Japanese boats without Pacific transfer.
submarine_local_nucleus.jan10_15_escalation: activate I-27 and I-37 if RN eastbound evidence continues = ~7 active/outbound.
submarine_local_nucleus.late_jan: RO-112 and one additional Southwest boat can lift practical on-station/outbound target toward 7-9.
submarine_local_nucleus.sentaka: 0 initial; 1-2 only after high-value fresh/stale contact geometry makes sprint-recontact useful.
submarine_local_nucleus.German_Monsun: sector-level handoff only, no unified tactical control; western/southwestern Ceylon-Arabian Sea information can cue Japanese eastern sectors.
